## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复从本机其他工具复制 Codex 实例时，会话继续写入导致复制中止的问题。macOS APFS 上的外部来源可以继续使用，复制得到已保存历史的独立快照，后续新消息不会持续同步。
- 会话数据库保留已提交的 WAL 数据；副本识别同一配置目录的别名、补齐扫描后新提交的会话文件，并排除已缺失文件的旧索引，显示排除数量。原始目录、登录与配置保留。
- 保留项目分组、归档状态及副本的账号连接；忽略尚未写完的最后一条会话记录。复制支持取消，失败或取消不会登记未完成实例。
- 直接使用已有目录仍要求先关闭来源客户端，后台检查同时兼容两种 Codex 控制套接字。

- Fixed instance copies failing when another local tool continues writing Codex sessions. External sources on macOS APFS can remain active while an independent snapshot of saved history is created; later messages do not continuously sync.
- Database snapshots include committed WAL data, recognize aliases of the same profile directory, capture newly indexed files committed after the inventory, and report stale indexes omitted from the copy. Original directories, login state and configuration are preserved.
- Project grouping, archive state and the copied instance's account connection are retained. An unfinished final session record is omitted. Copies can be cancelled; failed or cancelled jobs do not register incomplete instances.
- Directly reusing an existing directory still requires closing its source client. Background checks recognize both Codex control socket layouts.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。退出管理器后安装新版，账号、实例与本地配置保留。来源客户端可以继续运行。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。非 APFS 磁盘在来源文件变化时仍需停止写入后再复制。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the manager before installing the update; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. Source clients can keep running. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. On filesystems without APFS snapshots, stop source writes before copying changing files.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配取决于 Codex 版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration depend on the Codex version; Fast also depends on the model and provider.
